'''Clan Kaja''' was founded by a captured [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] named [[Kaja Honn]]. Framed for stealing [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] supplies, her captors carefully decided to send her to a facility on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] than risking conflict with their [[Sith-Mandalorian Alliance|Alliance]] with the Mandalorian clans.<ref name="Shackle" />

However, Honn organized and trained other unjustly held prisoners within the secret facility and fought the Guards to their freedom, calling themselves Clan Kaja. However, Kaja Honn died in the escape but her sacrifice made her an important figure within Mandalorian history and Clan Kaja kept her [[Shackle no.74631|broken shackle]] in reminder of their struggles. They went to obtain full clan status amongst the Mandalorians some years after their escape from Ziost.<ref name="Shackle" />
